build_flat_gpu_index: build a flat GPU index from a CPU IndexFlatL2 using faiss.index_cpu_to_gpu
build_ivf_gpu_index: build an IVF GPU index from a CPU IndexIVFFlat using faiss.index_cpu_to_gpu
search_flat_gpu_index: search a flat GPU index for k nearest neighbors using gpu_index_flat.search
train_ivf_gpu_index: train an IVF GPU index on database vectors using gpu_index_ivf.train before adding
